notes: 0.2.1：不再随包任何示例脚本与菜单桥 include，Scripts 目录随包为空，脚本改由独立仓库维护；右键齿轮改用 AHK 原生托盘消息，脚本无需任何配合即可弹出自己的菜单；脚本列表为空时直接提示把 .ahk 放进 Scripts，筛选无匹配另有一句提示；Scripts 目录缺失时启动自动重建，解压工具丢掉空目录也能用，「打开脚本文件夹」不再失效。
notes_en: 0.2.1: no sample scripts or menu-bridge include ship any more - Scripts is an empty folder and scripts live in their own repository; the gear cell now asks for a script's menu with AHK's native tray message, so scripts need no cooperation at all; an empty list says where .ahk files belong, and a filter that hides everything says so separately; a missing Scripts folder is recreated at startup, so an extractor that drops empty directories cannot break the list or File > Open scripts folder.
